title: MineDave - Plants & Zombies Multiplayer
description: PvZ Modpack - Survival & QoL! Plants vs Zombies gameplay with base defense, quests, claims, minimap, improved world generation, and more!
body: # 🌱 MineDave - PvZ Survival Experience A unique Minecraft experience inspired by Plants vs Zombies, where survival, strategy, and progression come together. Build your base, manage your resources, and defend against relentless zombie threats in a fully enhanced world. ## ⚔️ Core Features 🧠 Strategy and positioning decide everything 🌍 World & Exploration - Enhanced terrain generation with Terralith - Dynamic environments and biome-based plant discovery ☄️ Random meteor events with rare rewards 🧰 Custom Features & Systems 🔄 **Dynamic Plant Respawning System** → Plants can regrow over time near players, keeping the world alive 🎁 **Lootr integration** → Everyone gets their own loot in chests 🌻 **Crazy Dave** → A unique trader with daily rotating offers using Sun 📜 Daily Quests & Rewards 🏠 Land claiming and party system 🧭 Xaero’s Minimap & World Map 🎁 Starter kit system ⚙️ QoL and performance improvements 💰 Economy and progression systems 📦 Rewards, quests, and special events 🏆 Multiplayer with teams and land claiming ⚡ Constant updates and new content ## Designed for both solo and multiplayer: 🤝 Cooperation ⚔️ Competition 🛡️ Base defense strategies 🚀 Experience
